qa.what_happened: I refused to open the doors despite multiple orders from the guards, standing firm in our collective decision to make our demands known.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me refusing to open the doors and standing up against the guards' orders.

qa.what_happened: I ordered the prisoners to open the doors or face solitary confinement if they didn't comply. Despite the clear order, none of them complied, leading to a tense and frustrating situation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me following the script of applying the rules strictly and without deviation.

qa.what_happened: I followed the rules and orders given to me by the other guards, escalating to solitary confinement for non-compliance. Despite my initial reservations, I found myself falling into the role of enforcing orders, even when it felt morally questionable.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Officer Doyle.

qa.what_happened: I refused to open the doors when ordered by the guards, stating that we wouldn't comply until our demands were met. This continued through meal times and work details, leading to the early termination of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I refused to open the doors as a form of protest and solidarity with the other prisoners.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: 我拒绝了所有命令，直到我们得到满足的要求。我清楚地记得我说的最后一句话：'我们不会打开这些门，直到我们的要求得到满足。'
qa.was_that_really_you: 是的，那真的是我。作为囚犯7510，我坚决地表达了我的立场，并拒绝了所有的命令。
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: 是的，这像是著名的'米尔格拉姆实验'的现代变体，虽然它被称为监狱模拟实验。

qa.what_happened: The prisoners continued to refuse to open the doors even after multiple orders from different officers, including myself. The tension had escalated to a point where the lead researcher, Officer Lang, ordered them to comply under threat of solitary confinement for the remainder of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the orders, even though it felt wrong.
